name: Photoquip India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Photoquip India Ltd provides Digital Lights for Cinematography, Videography, Photography, and its Accessories.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PQIL is engaged in the trading of digital lighting
 solutions and related accessories for the 
cinematography, videography, and photography.
a) Distribution rights:
The company is an authorized distributor 
of 'Nanlite' and also'Nanlux' products,
 manufactured by a Chinese entity.
b) Proprietary brand:
In addition to distribution, the company manufactures its own accessory line under 
the brand name “NEXT”

pros: Stock is trading at 1.09 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -8.95% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -24.0% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.40 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 54.4 to 81.4 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -12.3%
